member.name: T:vaudio.CoordinateSystem
member.summary:
Coordinate system used by the debug window and for calculating listener-relative reverb directionality.
Internally, this SDK always computes in a left-handed space with Y+ up, X+ right and Z+ forward, same as Unity and Direct3D.

member.name: F:vaudio.CoordinateSystem.Default
member.summary:
Left-handed. Up = Y+, Forward = Z+, Right = X+. Identical to this SDK's internal space (no conversion applied).
Yaw 0 looks down Z+ and positive yaw turns right (towards X+).

member.name: F:vaudio.CoordinateSystem.Blender
member.summary:
Right-handed. Up = Z+, Forward = Y+, Right = X+. Matches Blender's Front (Numpad-1) view, which looks down Y+.
Yaw 0 looks down Y+ and positive yaw turns left (counter-clockwise around Z+, same as Blender's Z rotation).

member.name: F:vaudio.CoordinateSystem.Godot
member.summary:
Right-handed. Up = Y+, Forward = Z-, Right = X+. Matches Godot's camera/light forward convention (not the separate +Z "model front" convention Godot uses for imported assets). Same as OpenGL/glTF.
Yaw 0 looks down Z- and positive yaw turns left (counter-clockwise around Y+, same as Godot's Y rotation).

member.name: F:vaudio.CoordinateSystem.Unity
member.summary:
Left-handed. Up = Y+, Forward = Z+, Right = X+. Mathematically identical to .
Yaw 0 looks down Z+ and positive yaw turns right (towards X+).

member.name: F:vaudio.CoordinateSystem.Unreal
member.summary:
Left-handed. Up = Z+, Forward = X+, Right = Y+.
Yaw 0 looks down X+ and positive yaw turns right (towards Y+, same as FRotator).

member.name: F:vaudio.CoordinateSystem.OpenGL
member.summary:
Right-handed. Up = Y+, Forward = Z-, Right = X+. Same as OpenGL, glTF and Three.js. Mathematically identical to .
Yaw 0 looks down Z- and positive yaw turns left (counter-clockwise around Y+).
